conclusion: The PUD ordinance governing parcel 28-37-27-00-7 could not be located through automated online searches. PUD ordinances in Palm Bay are NOT codified in the municipal code — they are individual ordinances maintained by the City Clerk. The parcel appears to be an unplatted remainder within the Sandy Pines Preserve PUD (built 1998-2003). The PUD ordinance must be obtained directly from Palm Bay Land Development Division at (321) 733-3042 or landdevelopmentweb@palmbayfl.gov. The legal description references three recorded documents (PB 32/78, ORB 3636/2327, ORB 3731/2000) that should also be retrieved from the Brevard County Clerk to understand the parcel's full legal history.
